title: Article 320 — Functions of Public Service Commissions

content.overview: Article 320 sets out the functions of Public Service Commissions. It shall be the duty of the Union and State Commissions to conduct examinations for appointments to the services of the Union and the services of the State respectively. It shall also be the duty of the Commissions to advise on matters specified in the article, including methods of recruitment, principles of appointment/promotion/transfer, disciplinary matters affecting civil servants, claims for reimbursement of costs of legal proceedings, claims for pension in respect of injuries, and any other matter referred by the President or Governor. Parliament or the State Legislature may provide for additional functions. The President/Governor may make regulations specifying matters in which it shall not be necessary to consult the Commission.
content.glance: PSC duties: conduct recruitment examinations; advise on recruitment methods, appointments/promotions/transfers, discipline, injury pensions, and other referred matters. Additional functions by law. Regulations may limit consultation.
content.study:
Article 320 functions:
1. Examinations for appointments to Union services (UPSC) and State services (SPSC).
2. Advice on: methods of recruitment; principles to be followed in making appointments, promotions, transfers; suitability of candidates; disciplinary matters; reimbursement of legal costs; injury pensions; any other matter referred by President/Governor.
3. Additional functions may be conferred by parliamentary or State law.
4. Regulations by President/Governor may specify matters in which consultation is not necessary.

Examination: mandatory examination duty; advisory heads; regulations excluding consultation; advice not binding.

sections.heading: Core functions
sections.body:
1. Conduct examinations for appointments to services.
2. Advise on recruitment methods, appointment/promotion/transfer principles, discipline, legal-cost claims, injury pensions, and referred matters.
3. Additional functions by law.
4. President/Governor regulations may exclude specified matters from mandatory consultation.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What are the functions of Public Service Commissions under Article 320?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 320, it is the duty of the Union and State Public Service Commissions to conduct examinations for appointments to the services of the Union and the States respectively. The Commissions also advise on methods of recruitment, principles to be followed in appointments, promotions and transfers, disciplinary matters affecting persons serving under the Government, claims for reimbursement of costs of legal proceedings, claims for award of pensions in respect of injuries, and any other matter referred to them. Parliament or a State Legislature may place additional functions on the Commissions. The President or Governor may make regulations specifying matters in which it shall not be necessary for a Commission to be consulted.

examTips: Examinations + advisory role; consultation generally required unless regulations exclude.

keyTakeaways: Art 320: PSC examinations and advisory functions.
